Indian-Origin Businessman Posed as CIA Agent for Indonesian Defence Deals

An Indian-origin businessman, Gaurav Srivastava, allegedly posed as a CIA agent to secure multi-billion dollar defence deals with Indonesia. The proposed deals reportedly included the sale of 36 F-15 fighter jets. Srivastava's alleged deception was exposed, leading to the revelation of his impersonation attempt to the Indonesian President.
